title: Make mandatory requested-review disposition executable and fail-closed

human_actor.role: Product Owner, originating author and rights holder
human_actor.identity_proof_boundary: Repository and platform records attribute the directive to the named account context; they are not biometric or universal identity proof.

tools_and_adapters: GitHub API and Actions review tooling
QIK-VRT focused and full test suite
artificial_cognitive_actor.identity_and_observation_limits: Tool and model family information is runtime-supplied. No claim is made about hidden implementation internals, legal personhood, independent intent, authorship rights, an account-level Code Owner approval, or any external effect.

human_contributions.description: Directed completion of the requested-review lifecycle as an exact-head, fail-closed repository-internal mechanism; required that no account be impersonated and no approval, merge, release, deployment, publication or external effect be fabricated.

artificial_cognitive_contributions.description: Identified the missing executable exact-head requested-review disposition path and bound the observed PR #640 review-state limitation.

Drafted the trusted-default-branch executor, unprivileged review signal, read-only snapshotter, fail-closed decision and target-resolution cores, focused tests, policy and documentation bindings, and integrity materialization plan.

joint_components.human_part: purpose, constraints and decision to complete the lifecycle
joint_components.artificial_cognitive_part: repository observation, implementation, test and evidence design

authorization.current_directive: Product Owner directed that the previously required review-lifecycle implementation be completed rather than silently left pending.
authorization.identity_boundary: The executor must report GitHub's actual signer and may not impersonate @Goldkelch or claim an unrecorded account-level approval.

observed_defect.missing_implementation: No workflow bound the policy to an exact-head review disposition; the collective-review workflow was intentionally evidence-only and read-only.

reproduction.api_result: GitHub REST rejected same-account approval with HTTP 422 Review Can not approve your own pull request.

outputs.self_binding_rule: The future Git commit and repository-native integrity outputs containing this work-unit file bind its exact bytes; no impossible in-file self-hash is claimed.

required_behavior: Run write-capable review lifecycle logic only from trusted default-branch bytes; inspect candidate bytes through GitHub APIs.
Use a zero-permission review signal and a separately trusted executor; never pass an artifact, candidate byte, shell fragment or PR-controlled workflow content into the write-capable execution path.

Reobserve the current base, exact head, tree, current test-merge context, changed paths and bounded rendered diff, comments, reviews, user and team requested-review history, unresolved threads, competing/superseded state, and observable Actions checks plus legacy statuses on the head and test-merge contexts; fail closed when GitHub files/diff completeness boundaries or counts do not agree.
Treat observed Actions/status data as evidence-limited: it cannot establish branch-protection completeness, merge readiness, Code Owner approval, release readiness or an external effect.

Reobserve after a run only when GitHub's API binds that run to exactly one current open PR with the expected workflow name, path and event; reobserve on eligible status events and on the default-branch reconciliation schedule so an already submitted review can be reconsidered when observable gates later change.

Record one deduplicated exact-binding COMMENT_WITH_BLOCKER review when no eligible requested reviewer has recorded an exact-head APPROVE, REQUEST_CHANGES or COMMENT_WITH_BLOCKER disposition; render PR-controlled evidence as bounded JSON-safe, Markdown-inert excerpts while retaining the full exact binding hash.
Bind any lifecycle comment to commit_id and reobserve both its returned review state and the candidate immediately after the write.
Fail the lifecycle check while the review condition remains unresolved.
Never auto-approve, auto-merge, impersonate a GitHub account, or claim an external effect.
